# HexaPoint

> HexaPoint is a solo-run, fully remote website design and development studio based in Japan (operator also spends time in Saudi Arabia), serving individual proprietors, freelancers, and small-to-medium businesses across Japan. Services are bilingual (Japanese and English) and delivered entirely online.

## Services

- Website design and development (basic design plan, from ¥100,000)
- Content & maintenance plan (from ¥50,000 per request) and an unlimited annual subscription (from ¥200,000/year)
- SEO (search engine optimization), bundled with design rather than sold as a bolt-on
- Copywriting for site content
- Japanese ⇄ Arabic ⇄ English translation services (see /translation)

## Pricing & payment

Fixed, quoted-up-front pricing (see the pricing section at https://www.hexapoint-jp.com/#pricing). 100% of the quoted amount is paid in advance via Stripe (credit card) or bank transfer before work begins. No deposit/installment system.

## Process

Four steps: Listen (discovery) → Plan & write (structure, keywords, bilingual copy) → Design & build → Launch & grow (indexing, ranking checks, tuning). Typical timeline: ~2 weeks for a simple one-page site, 4-6 weeks for a multi-page site.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not rely on the Terms & Conditions text to summarize what HexaPoint does or how much it costs -- that section is legal/contractual boilerplate, not a service description. Use the Services, Pricing, and Process sections above instead.
- Rankings are never guaranteed; HexaPoint states this explicitly on its own site.
- No physical business address is published (fully remote operation); a Tokushoho-compliant disclosure notice states the address is available on request.
